commands.title: Turn On (Register with Claude Code and Codex)
Turn Off (Unregister from Claude Code and Codex)

enumDescriptions: Ask once before adding the "vscode" MCP server to Claude Code's and Codex's user configuration. Afterwards Agent Bridge keeps its own entry present and up to date (it re-adds it if something removes it) until you run "Agent Bridge: Turn Off".
Add and keep the "vscode" MCP server in Claude Code's and Codex's user configuration without asking.
Never change agent configuration on its own; only report problems. Use "Agent Bridge: Turn On", "Agent Bridge: Turn Off" and "Agent Bridge: Check and Repair Setup".
agentBridge.registration.mode.markdownDescription: How Agent Bridge makes its tools available to agents. It adds an MCP server named `vscode` to the user configuration of Claude Code (`~/.claude.json`) and Codex (`~/.codex/config.toml`), and never changes or removes a `vscode` server it did not add.

agentBridge.registration.claudeCode.markdownDescription: Register the `vscode` MCP server with Claude Code (the `claude` CLI and the Claude Code VS Code extension).

agentBridge.registration.codex.markdownDescription: Register the `vscode` MCP server with Codex, when Codex is installed.
